title: tastewatch digest: 2026-10-05
description:
First tastewatch patrol — baseline week (2026-09-28 .. 2026-10-05). 7 commits merged on main; population < 10, so all 7 audited. Note: docs/CONSTITUTION.md is missing (P1 seed senshac-media-runner-83ab filed per Article IX); verdicts below use the article set from the tastewatch definition as stand-in.

## 1. Verdict table

| sha | subject | verdict | citation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9a33852 | build: create media runner image with Nix (#19) | diverges | Art V (message noise); new: dual lockfile |
| 11d21e4 | build: pin published media runner image (#20) | conforms | Art I (see note) |
| b2a5420 | fix: remove redundant dry-run env file write (#21) | conforms | Art I |
| b582691 | chore(flake): add cachix binary caches (#22) | conforms | Art I (trailing-newline nit) |
| 2b8619c | Remove project model overrides (#23) | conforms | Art I (title-prefix idiom drift, minor) |
| ea6651e | fix(warren): pin accessible agent image (#24) | conforms | Art I (fix-chain, see 3) |
| fcbf4b1 | chore(warren): remove repo agent image override (#25) | conforms | Art I |

Notes: 11d21e4's own verification admits the pinning host could not pull the registry artifact (token lacks GHCR package-read); digest was verified by the publisher CI run instead. Acceptable but weaker than "pull and verify locally" — the consumer remains correctly digest-pinned, no `latest` anywhere in checked-in consumers. b582691 adds personal/team cachix substituters (public keys, owner-controlled trust boundary — fine) but drops the flake.nix trailing newline.

## 2. Divergence rate

1/7 diverging this week = 14%. Last week: no prior digest — this is the baseline. 14% is the bar future weeks are measured against.

## 3. Most important divergence: 9a33852 — second lockfile with no parity gate

9a33852 ("build: create media runner image with Nix", 903 insertions) introduces yarn.lock (693 lines, "yarn lockfile v1") into a repository whose development, tests, and bun-version CI all run on bun (bun.lock, 185 lines, .lockb hash). The Nix image build consumes yarn.lock via `fetchYarnDeps { yarnLock = ./yarn.lock; }` in flake.nix, while `bun test` consumes bun.lock. Two sources of truth for one dependency set, with no gate keeping them in lockstep: a future dependency update that touches only bun.lock would change tested behavior while the published image silently ships the older set — or worse, the reverse. This is exactly the dependency-drift class the repo's own dependency-hygiene skill exists to prevent. The same commit also violates comment/message discipline (Art V): the commit message embeds ~40 lines of raw act/podman dry-run log plus literal `\n` escape sequences. The Nix image build itself is sound and well-pinned (flake.lock, digest-pinned consumer in process-media.yml:30).

## 4. Auditor-population precision check

None. .seeds/plans.jsonl is empty and .seeds/issues.jsonl holds a single closed, non-auditor issue; no gatewatch, ratchetwatch, or nightwatch seeds were filed since the (nonexistent) last digest. Precision: undefined for all three — no data for any autonomy promotion this cycle.

## 5. Proposed amendment (one, per Art IX — proposed, not applied)

New executable gate, `scripts/check-lockfile-parity` (bun): parse the name@version set from bun.lock and the `name@version` entries from yarn.lock; exit non-zero on any asymmetry, printing the differing packages. Wire into ci.yml alongside the existing bun test step. Amendment to docs/CONSTITUTION.md (once restored): "Article V (dependency hygiene): a repository maintains exactly one lockfile per runtime; the image build and the test runner must consume the same lockfile. A second lockfile requires a checked-in parity gate in the same commit." Alternative if the dual runtime is intentional: generate yarn.lock from bun.lock in one commit and freeze manual edits.

## 6. Trajectory

Holding, with two early drift signals (dual lockfile; config-layer patch-then-delete chain in .warren/config.yaml across ea6651e→fcbf4b1, missing test class: "pinned agent image is pullable/authorized") that a restored constitution and one parity gate should close next cycle.
